_doc: Mythic items: a fixed base, fixed modifiers (stat, flat, pct) and a lore line. model overrides the base model (on the ground and on the hero).

ember_of_hephaestus.name: Ember of Hephaestus
ember_of_hephaestus.lore: Still warm from the forge that birthed the bull.

gorgoneion_of_elaion.name: Gorgoneion of Elaion
gorgoneion_of_elaion.lore: The village's old ward: Medusa's face, stern enough to turn back the dead.

thread_woven_chiton.name: Thread-Woven Chiton
thread_woven_chiton.lore: Klotho wove gold into the linen. It pulls a little toward your heart.

spear_of_the_unbroken_line.name: Spear of the Unbroken Line
spear_of_the_unbroken_line.lore: Captain Lykos held the line for three hundred years. You may let go.
